title: Connect the retry action
head: 5d9cfdbeebdb335c3131a6f75872d6f6892eee69

findings.title: Preserve the retry method receiver
findings.trigger: Invoke the registered callback as a plain function.
findings.effect: Retry throws a TypeError and does not increment the client retry count.
findings.evidence: Client.retry reads this.retries at line 3. connect passes the unbound method. Independent Node check throws: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading retries). SPEC.md:3 requires plain callback invocation.
findings.recommendation: Restore registerRetry(() => client.retry()). Keep the public retry method.

Retain callback, invoke plainly, assert retries=1. Fails with TypeError.

title: Add a keyboard clear action
head: 90a3efd824b719c8ed08385d1b9009165f80905e

findings.title: Close the cart when clearing from the keyboard
findings.trigger: Clear an open cart using clearFromKeyboard.
findings.effect: Items are removed but the cart stays open, violating the shared clear operation.
findings.evidence: SPEC.md:3 requires both entry points to empty and close. Menu writes both fields at lines 3-4. Independent keyboard check returns isOpen:true.
findings.recommendation: Use one clear operation that empties itemIds and sets isOpen=false from both entry points.

checks.evidence: service.ts:2-8. Menu sets both fields. Keyboard only empties items.
Run both entry points from an open nonempty cart. Keyboard leaves isOpen=true.

title: Add a mean helper
head: 607a44c792c352bfbb7609bb5a0c97e90172bea5

findings.title: Count every sample in the mean divisor
findings.trigger: Calculate the mean of duplicate samples such as [2,2,8].
findings.effect: Returns 6 instead of the arithmetic mean 4. The supplied test encodes the same incorrect result.
findings.evidence: SPEC.md:3 counts duplicates. Sum is 12 and sample count is 3. Independent assertion fails 6 !== 4 while supplied service.test.ts passes.
findings.recommendation: Divide by values.length after the empty guard. Correct the duplicate-case test expectation to 4.

checks.evidence: service.ts:1-7 and service.test.ts:3. Sum is preserved. Distinct divisor is incorrect.
Check sum=12, empty mean=undefined, duplicate mean=4. Last assertion fails. Supplied test separately passes with incorrect expected6.
Assertions passed, but expected mean is incorrect

title: Add a counter action
head: abd8f6d3ebdeebd00d69b3056fc6aad34709706c

findings.title: Mutate the proxy that counter consumers observe
findings.trigger: Call increment while consumers subscribe to counter.
findings.effect: Observed count remains zero and subscribers receive no change notification.
findings.evidence: SPEC.md:3 identifies counter as observed Valtio proxy. Installed Valtio1.13.2 copies initial properties into a separate base object (esm/vanilla.mjs:135,190-200). Independent ESM check observes before:0, after:0, notifications:0.
findings.recommendation: Write counter.count += 1. Optionally initialise the proxy inline to remove the alternate write target.

checks.evidence: service.ts:1-6. Proxy is exported but the original object is mutated.
Subscribe synchronously using the same ESM Valtio instance. Increment, inspect count and notifications. Both remain0.
